title: C4 research and DevEnv recommendations
status: Research saved; user requested diagrams after committing the research
summary: Use C4 to communicate responsibilities, boundaries, runtime units, and collaborations. Begin with context and container views, then document local development deployment. Do not require all four levels.

sources.finding: C4 offers system, container, component, and code abstractions plus supporting views; notation and tooling are independent.
Recommended starting view: people and directly connected software systems, without implementation detail.
Recommended view of applications, data stores, responsibilities, technologies, and communication. A container need not be Docker.
Optional decomposition within one container; create only when it adds value.
Optional fine detail, preferably generated on demand rather than maintained by hand.
Shows runtime instances and infrastructure in one explicit environment.
Use sparingly for important or complicated runtime interactions.
Include scope, title, legend, element types and responsibilities; label directed relationships and communication protocols.
A shared model with multiple views avoids duplicated elements and supports querying and export.
Mermaid documents its C4 syntax as experimental; avoid making that syntax the authoritative model.

include: Only confirmed direct external software-system integrations
avoid: Treating WMS example content as a live integration

notes: Shared is a library, not an independently running container.
Label HTTP/JSON operations and the NDJSON test event stream.
Filesystem data stores can be containers without being separate services.

recommendedViews.purpose: Make machine boundaries, processes, and server-local paths explicit.
notes: Do not imply the browser and server must be on the same machine.
Git and test routes are enabled outside production; do not invent a production deployment.

recommendedViews.purpose: Explain complex interactions if needed after the initial views.
candidates: Clone staging, replacement, restoration and warning
Ticket change, expected version and conflict
Test subprocess, event stream and cached result

maintenance: One authoritative structured architecture model, with derived visual and readable views.
Use stable element identities and reuse relationships across views.
Distinguish observed current architecture from proposed architecture.
Link responsibilities to implementation evidence and review when boundaries change.
Evaluate existing local modelling tools before building a custom tool; no hosted upload is needed.
typeDetectorRelationship: C4 identifies architectural responsibilities and collaborations; Type Detector examines meanings, invariants, states, and contracts within them. Neither every Type nor every Angular component is a C4 architectural component.
limits: Recommendations were based on official guidance and selective repository inspection, not a full integration inventory or runtime validation. Tool-specific JSON support was not verified.
nextStep: After the approved research commit, create context, container, and local-development views from a single authoritative JSON model. Keep diagram work uncommitted unless separately requested.
